panels.title: CPU Tctl
panels.description: 7800X3D Tctl. The chip throttles at 89 °C.

panels.title: GPU Junction
panels.description: 9070 XT hotspot. Limit is 110 °C; sustained ~300 W compute sits at 90-105 with the fans already at 100 %.

panels.title: Booted at
panels.description: A step here is a reboot; an unexplained one is a hang/reset. Cross-check with `journalctl --list-boots`.

panels.title: Pressure Stall (PSI)
panels.description: Share of wall time at least one task waited on the resource. Memory 'full' near 1 is swap death, the one software failure that looks like a hang.

panels.title: CPU Temperatures
panels.description: Tctl is the control temperature (throttle at 89); Tccd1 the die. Curve Optimizer is at zero since 2026-10-09 (hosts/orchid/hardware.nix).

panels.title: Per-Core Frequency
panels.description: Governor is `performance` (floor 4.2 GHz); boost ~5.0-5.05 GHz single core.

panels.title: Load Average
panels.description: 16 threads.

panels.title: GPU Temperatures
panels.description: Junction (hotspot) limit is 110 °C. Measured: ~24 °C over edge during steady generation, 30-33 °C for the seconds it draws its full cap.

panels.title: Junction − Edge
panels.description: A delta that is high at moderate power, or that climbs over weeks, is paste or mount. Short spikes during power bursts are thermal lag and normal.

panels.title: Power & Cap
panels.description: Cap is 297 W from LACT (hosts/orchid/hardware.nix); stock is 330 W. The cap is the only thermal lever: fans are already at 100 % under sustained load.

panels.title: Fan Duty
panels.description: The commanded PWM duty, not a measured speed: this card's tach reads 0 RPM under amdgpu (VBIOS 113-R907XTGOL-F60), so fan1_input is useless. Zero-RPM mode is on, so 0 at idle is expected.

panels.title: GPU Clocks
panels.description: MHz.

panels.title: GPU Voltage
panels.description: Offset is 0 mV since 2026-10-09: -100 mV hung the MES/gfx queues under Strata compute three times on 2026-10-07.

panels.title: CPU Package Power (RAPL)
panels.description: Zen 4's RAPL counters via node-exporter. The kernel makes energy_uj root-only, so hosts/orchid/system/strata-exporter.nix chmods it at boot; without that this panel is empty. The iGPU's hwmon has no power sensor on this kernel, so it is not used.

panels.title: Energy per Generated Mtoken
panels.description: (GPU W + CPU package W + 40 W for board, DIMMs, NVMe, fans) / 0.9 PSU efficiency, divided by Strata's wall-clock generation rate over the last minute. Wall clock includes prefill and the idle gaps between an agent's turns, so an agent session reads 3-4 kWh/Mtoken while pure generation is ~2 (IQ3_S) or ~1.8 (IQ2_XS). Only drawn while generating more than 5 t/s.

panels.title: Model
panels.description: From Strata's GET /metrics. Empty while the server is down.

panels.title: Doing
panels.description: idle, reading the prompt, thinking, writing a tool call or an answer.

panels.title: Live t/s
panels.description: Generation rate over the last ~2 s; 0 while idle.

panels.title: Context
panels.description: Tokens of context in the current request.

panels.title: Experts in VRAM
panels.description: More cached experts = faster generation. IQ3_S fits 4116 in 7.9 GB.

panels.title: Up
panels.description: 1 while the server answers /metrics.

panels.title: Generation Speed
panels.description: tokens/s while generating. Live is a ~2 s window; request mean is since the request's first token; last request is the engine's own figure for the request that just finished. Draft-assisted file writes run ~85 t/s, thinking ~55-60 (IQ2_XS) or ~50 (IQ3_S).

panels.title: Throughput (1 m)
panels.description: From the server's running totals, so they survive restarts of the scrape. Wall-clock includes idle gaps between turns; the other two are the engine's rates during the work itself.

panels.title: Prefill Speed
panels.description: New prompt tokens read per second. ~1200 t/s cold; far higher when most of the prompt is reused from the KV cache (short reads amortise badly, so small numbers on tiny turns are normal).

panels.title: Expert Cache & Draft
panels.description: Per request. Hit rate is the share of expert lookups served from the VRAM cache; the rest stream from RAM over PCIe. Draft acceptance is the MTP layer's success rate — ~85 % on code, lower on prose.

panels.title: Context & Reply Length
panels.description: A reply that climbs to 16384 is one that hit the output cap (a thinking spiral).

panels.title: Requests & Tokens (rate)
panels.description: 5-minute rates from the server's totals.

panels.title: DIMM Temperatures
panels.description: spd5118 on-DIMM sensors. Reached 66 °C during the 2026-10-07 Strata run and 72 °C in a passing 1 h stressapptest on 2026-10-09; EXPO at 6000 is clean to there.

panels.title: ZFS ARC
panels.description: zfs_arc_max is 16 GiB on the kernel command line.
